expression: (http.host eq "phim.bluesia.net" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and (http.request.uri.path eq "/" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/list/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/movie/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/settings") and not http.request.uri.query contains "_rsc=" and not any(http.request.headers["rsc"][*] eq "1") and not any(http.request.headers["next-router-prefetch"][*] eq "1"))
description: Blueflare public full documents: cache safe Next routes, bypass RSC and prefetch representations
